Module org.slb4j
Package org.slb4j.handler

Class FileHandler

java.lang.Object
org.slb4j.handler.AbstractFileHandler
org.slb4j.handler.FileHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, LayoutConfigurable, LogHandler
public final class FileHandler extends AbstractFileHandler
A log handler that writes log entries to a file. It supports log rotation triggered by file size, number of entries, or time.

      public FileHandler(String name, String fileName, boolean append) throws IOException
      Constructs a new FileHandler.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the handler
      fileName - the file name of the log file including its path as a string
      append - if true, then bytes will be written to the end of the file rather than the beginning
